thread:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — the deus-13b int6 bring-up from last night shows a small but consistent hit on long-form recall and a 12% cost reduction vs int8. thinking about a conservative GTN recommendation. TL;DR below.
Jake Park: can you paste the metric diffs?
Maria Chen: sure — short summary: overall pass rate (GTN eval set) down 1.6pp, longform recall (>=3 relevant spans) down 3.8pp, latency p95 +18ms, unit GPU cost -12%. sample slices where recall regressed are mirrored to /evals/deus/int6/regressions.
Leo Ramos: rough traffic impact if we switch primary to int6?
Maria Chen: estimated unit-econ: tokens/unit cost ~0.88x current, 12% infra savings. For product mix (30% longform), expected quality-weighted hit ~= 0.7pp across sessions.
Sophie K: product will care about visible regression on long answers. Can we route only short-form to int6?
Maria Chen: yes — hybrid routing looks promising: short (<64 tokens) -> int6, long -> int8 fallback. That preserves longform recall and keeps ~7% overall cost savings.
Jake Park: ops question — is KV cache behavior different on int6 quant? any cold-start tail changes?
Maria Chen: minor kvcache eviction bump on int6 due to slightly higher memory compaction; cold-start p99 +45ms in worst slice (logged). not huge but visible on multi-turn.
Leo Ramos: for GTN recommendation we should score by a unit metric that combines token cost + quality delta. any scorecard?
Maria Chen: uploaded a quick scorecard snapshot: `deus_int6_score = -0.12 * cost_savings_pct + 1.5 * recall_drop_pp` (lower is better). plugging numbers -> score ~ 4.6 (bad). But hybrid routing score ~1.9 (acceptable).
onboard-bot: deploy-check — canary plan template created: /runbooks/canary/deus-hybrid-v1.md
Sophie K: idea: start 10% traffic hybrid canary for 48h, attach quick eval hooks (GTN slice A/B) and alert on recall delta >1pp.
Jake Park: +1. also add latency SLO monitor for p95 tail +20ms.
Maria Chen: action items: 1) create hybrid routing flag + canary (I'll open PR), 2) add GTN slice monitors (Sophie), 3) run 24h synthetic load to validate kvcache tail (Leo). i'll post PR link in the thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Jake Park: thanks — if hybrid stabilizes we can recommend gradual roll to GTN with negotiated SLA caveats.
Maria Chen: noted. I'll include a short blurb for GTN: "Recommend hybrid routing: default to int6 for short responses to capture majority cost savings; fallback to int8 for multi-turn/longform to avoid recall regressions. Start with 10% canary, expand with evidence."
